name: Air quality management area
fact: 498 areas; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2026-04-15; all data from authoritative sources.
gate: AQMA geometry is material environmental context, but current designation documentation, pollutant/objective details and exact parcel intersection remain required.

name: Air quality management areas design surface
fact: On the platform; expected 643 records; ad hoc updates; design notes warn the source is a snapshot and may require further Defra work for currency.
gate: Design status and snapshot coverage do not prove a current parcel-level air-quality constraint or mitigation requirement.

name: Flood storage area
fact: 510 areas; 1 provider; collector 2026-05-19; new data 2025-08-08; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Storage-area geometry is flood-management context; authoritative Environment Agency currency and exact parcel intersection remain required.

name: Flood storage areas design surface
fact: Test and iterate; expected 509 records; quarterly update expectation; related to Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning.
gate: Expected cadence and source relationship do not establish current geometry, operational status or site-specific flood consequence.

name: Coastal change management area
fact: 0 records; 0 providers; no collector attempt; new data N/A; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Coverage gap only; no platform records cannot establish absence of a coastal-change policy area.

name: Coastal change management areas design surface
fact: Official design surface identifies the related coastal-change-management-area dataset.
gate: Design linkage is not an adopted local-plan policy polygon, shoreline-management conclusion or exact parcel relation.

name: Design code
fact: 21 design codes; 10 providers; collector 2026-07-16; new data 2024-06-11; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: A policy record requires current status, adopted document and applicable area before affecting a candidate site.

name: Design code area
fact: 11 areas; 6 providers; collector 2026-07-05; new data 2022-07-06; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Old area data cannot be assumed current and must be linked to an operative design code and exact parcel intersection.

name: Design code specification
fact: Specification last updated 2024-11-19; defines design-code and design-code-area datasets, linked by design-code reference and supporting CSV, GeoJSON, GML, Geopackage, WFS or ArcGIS API.
gate: Schema conformity supports exchange only; policy adoption, currency and parcel applicability remain separate evidence gates.

name: Design code area type
fact: 10 category codes; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-20; new data 2024-06-11; includes urban-neighbourhood, suburbs, villages and industrial-areas.
gate: Area-type vocabulary is classification only and cannot establish density, permitted form or site capacity.

name: Development corporation boundary
fact: 13 boundaries; 2 providers; collector 2026-06-30; new data 2026-05-04; mixed MHCLG-created and other-source data.
gate: Boundary inclusion may change governance context but does not itself grant permission, allocate land or establish development capacity.

name: Educational establishment
fact: 47,047 establishments; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2024-07-26; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Establishment points support amenity context only; no route, capacity availability, catchment access or parcel score is inferred.

name: Educational establishment design surface
fact: Test and iterate; expected 50,000 records; weekly frequency; Get Information about Schools identified as useful source.
gate: Design expectations do not make point records current accessibility, school-place availability or deliverability evidence.

name: Infrastructure project
fact: 233 projects; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2023-09-29; boundaries inform EIA consultation and may change.
gate: Project boundary is consultation context, not a final development consent order, construction status or exact parcel impact.

name: Infrastructure project type
fact: 10 project-type codes; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2025-02-13; includes energy, transport, water, waste and generating-station.
gate: Type vocabulary is not project geometry, decision status, programme or parcel evidence.

name: Infrastructure project document
fact: 0 records; 0 providers; no collector attempt; mixed/MHCLG-created origin warning.
gate: Empty document collection cannot establish that a project lacks a DCO, decision notice or other authoritative document.

name: Infrastructure project document type
fact: 5 document types; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2025-05-08; includes development-consent-order and decision-notice.
gate: Document-type category is not the signed document or its legal effect.

name: Infrastructure project event
fact: 9 event records; 1 provider; collector 2026-06-18; new data 2025-02-13; entries include acceptance, examination, decided, post-decision and withdrawn, with duplicate/misspelled recommendation forms visible.
gate: Event vocabulary requires normalized project-specific event evidence and dates before determining current status.

name: Infrastructure project decision
fact: 4 decision codes; 1 provider; collector 2026-06-19; new data 2024-02-02: consent-granted, consent-rejected, withdrawn and appealed.
gate: Decision vocabulary is not a project decision record or signed development-consent documentation.

name: Infrastructure project log
fact: 0 records; 0 providers; no collector attempt; mixed/MHCLG-created origin warning.
gate: No platform log cannot establish absence of project events, examinations or decisions.

name: Nature improvement area
fact: 12 areas; 1 provider; collector 2025-10-19; new data 2024-07-30; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Area geometry is ecological strategy context and requires authoritative currency and exact parcel intersection.

name: Nature improvement areas design surface
fact: Expected 12 records; ad hoc frequency; design notes state consultation use still needs understanding.
gate: Programme-area context is not a statutory designation, BNG result or parcel-level ecological conclusion.

name: Enterprise zone design research
fact: Official screen research identifies insufficiently precise national mapping and the need for a data standard.
gate: Enterprise-zone incentives or status cannot be assigned to a parcel without current authoritative boundary and order evidence.

name: Areas benefiting from flood defences design archive
fact: Archived in 2025; former dataset retired and superseding reduction-in-risk dataset also no longer updated; design notes prefer flood zones plus existing/proposed defences.
gate: Retired or archived layers must not be used as current parcel protection or residual-risk evidence.
